messages.subject: Re: LaTeX Fonts in R (Graphs)
parts:
Ron,

Thank you.


showtext does not work with RStudio. It does work with R. It does not
work with knitR under LyX. Stooped looking for the cause.

extrafont needs a little help:

1) Add them to Fontbook (so they wind up in ~/Library/Fonts

2) translate them to TTF :-)-O

3) do a font_import("~/Library/Fonts") (faster than the default).

and there you are. I can access them in ggplot2 like so:

theme_bw(base_family="IBM Plex Sans")

Works in R, Rstudio and LyX/knitR.

greetings, el
